description: Suspend the current task and ask a clarifying question. The agent pauses execution and waits for an answer before continuing. Use for genuine blockers that cannot be resolved by the agent itself.

question.description: The precise question that needs answering before the task can continue.

ask_node.description: Node ID of the agent to ask (agent-to-agent clarification). Leave blank for human-targeted questions.

target_role.description: Human role needed to answer (e.g. 'pm', 'devops'). Used for agent-to-human clarification when ask_node is blank.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for an answer before applying the assumption. Default: 86400 (24h).

timeout_action.description: What to do if timeout fires: 'use_assumption' (continue with assumption value) or 'fail' (mark task as failed).

assumption.description: The assumption to use if timeout fires and timeout_action is 'use_assumption'.
